canonical_project: Bundelkhand Data Centre/AI Hub (regional plan incl. Jhansi)
owner: Government of Uttar Pradesh (BIDA area proposal)
notes: CM Yogi Adityanath (21 May 2026) directed officials to explore a major data centre cluster in the Bundelkhand Industrial Development Authority (BIDA) area - Jhansi is the gateway city of UP's Bundelkhand region - as part of the UP Data Centre Cluster (UPDCC) with a 5 GW AI compute corridor ambition by 2040; UP Data Centre Policy 2026 (Jul 2026) offers extra land subsidies for Bundelkhand/Purvanchal. Regional/policy announcement only - no specific facility or investor named in Jhansi district; only institutional (university) data centres exist there.
